data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for the Adjust analytics and attribution service
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to integrate with the Adjust analytics and attribution platform. Provides mechanisms to track app events, attribute user acquisition sources, and configure advanced tracking parameters across Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to track attribution and marketing campaigns for your mobile app using Adjust
You require deep link handling and deferred deep link management on iOS and Android
avoid_when: You do not use the Adjust service for attribution or analytics
You only require basic in-app logging or crash reporting without attribution features
strengths: Official SDK maintained by Adjust with regular updates aligning with native iOS and Android SDKs
Supports advanced features such as third-party sharing settings and signature validation
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the proprietary Adjust backend service
Native iOS and Android configurations are required
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific configuration for Android and iOS native SDKs and initialization in Dart.
